Map a soil-moisture layer field name to its 1-based layer index.

detaileddescription.para: Recognises per-layer soil-moisture fields written as <prefix><n> where <prefix> is any entry of SOILM_PREFIXES (SOILW, SOILM, SMOIS, SOILMOIST, case-insensitive) and <n> is any positive integer. The number of layers is NOT fixed - it is taken from whatever the input file supplies. Returns 0 for any name that is not a recognised soil-moisture layer field.

simplesect.para: Positive layer index, or 0 if not a soil-moisture layer field

briefdescription.para: Route a single soil-moisture layer into the 3D SOILM array.

detaileddescription.para: Assembles the per-layer offline fields (see soilm_layer_from_name) into SOILM(:,:,n). SOILM is allocated lazily on the first layer received and its soil-layer dimension is grown on demand (preserving already-stored layers), so an arbitrary number of soil layers is supported without hardcoding a count. nSOIL is kept in sync with the current number of layers. In coupled runs SOILM is provided directly as a full 3D field and this path is not used.

parameterdescription.para: Original field name (for the informational warning)

briefdescription.para: Ensure a prerequisite met field is populated, deriving it on demand.

detaileddescription.para: If name was already provided (read/imported) or derived this timestep it is left untouched; otherwise it is derived. This lets derive_field resolve its own dependency chain (PS -> PEDGE -> PMID -> AIRDEN/DELP/...) regardless of ordering, while never overwriting a value supplied by the host/reader.

parameterdescription.para: Name of the prerequisite field to ensure
